'''Korfo II''' was a celestial body<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> located in the [[Korfo system/Legends|Korfo system]]. It was a part of the [[Arrowhead]], [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Korfo II lay on the [[Commenor Run/Legends|Commenor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Cirius system/Legends|Cirius]] and [[Tepasi system/Legends|Tepasi systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Imperial Bank of Korfo II]], and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained the position of [[Imperial Liaison|Imperial Liaison Officer]] to Korfo II, with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pandur]] holding the position at one point.<ref name="GG4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Korfo II was introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook authored by [[Troy Denning]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG4" /> "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, placed Korfo II in the "Imperial Core" [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Korfo [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Korfo II, in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
